sn47.15:1.2: atha kho āyasmā bāhiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bāhiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn47.15:1.3: “sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti”.
sn47.15:1.4: tasmātiha tvaṃ bāhiya, ādimeva visodhehi kusalesu dhammesu.
sn47.15:1.7: yato kho te bāhiya, sīlañca suvisuddhaṃ bhavissati, diṭṭhi ca ujukā. tato tvaṃ bāhiya, sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāveyyāsi.
sn47.15:2.2: idha tvaṃ bāhiya, kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.15:2.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharasi ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.15:2.6: yato kho tvaṃ bāhiya, sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāvessasi, tato tuyhaṃ bāhiya, yā ratti vā divaso vā āgamissati, vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no parihānī”ti.
sn47.15:3.1: atha kho āyasmā bāhiyo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn47.15:3.2: atha kho āyasmā bāhiyo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
sn47.15:3.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn47.15:3.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā bāhiyo arahataṃ ahosīti.
